rule.name: UrlPathUsedAsFile
rule.message: URL.getFile() and URL.getPath() return the percent-encoded form of the path, so a directory with a space (%20) or another character that URLs encode gives a path that does not exist on disk, and the file looks missing. Convert the URL instead: new File(url.toURI()) or Path.of(url.toURI()), or URLDecoder.decode(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8) when the URL is known to be a file: URL. An exception fits for a jar: URL that is opened as a FileSystem or read as a stream.
